description.en-us: This product is a power supply expansion device designed for P2S printers. It allows for non-destructive plug-and-play installation and is also compatible with buffers. It provides two 24V MX3.0 4-pin connectors and two 5V Type-C connectors, supporting both internal and external power supply.
description.zh-cn: 该产品是为P2S打印机打造的供电拓展产品，可实现无损对插安装，同时兼容缓冲器使用，提供24V MX3.0 4Pin与5V Type-C各两个，支持内部与外部供电使用
